messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: LANE-RISK takes nothing until the 24th. Data lane: Tuesday evening is the DNS change, Wednesday night is Bruno's own feature-store rebuild and the evening is the loader release, Friday evening is reconciliation, Saturday evening is the reindex hold.

messages.author: Wren Haviland
messages.text: Dario has every secondary block on Thursday and he does not hold the fraud runbook cert, so Thursday's sessions are out for a fraud change.

messages.author: Tunde Abara
messages.text: The promo peak-trading freeze covers every lane Sunday and Monday. Two pools in one night is Bruno and me together, and nobody has asked.

title: SVCOPS-0006 risk lane suspension — fraud pools
